verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs say users can create OAuth 2 credentials, with PKCE support so a client can avoid shipping secret keys. That gives an agent a delegated credential rather than the user's password. The API surface itself is narrow (appending to notes, listing bookmarks), but nothing in the evidence describes scopes, per-credential permission limits, or least-privilege controls. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or granular permissions, read-only or per-resource restriction options, credential revocation/expiry controls, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
